item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"claim1","claim_type":"core","weight":40,"statement":"Any output field whose annotation has `dict` as its origin is classified as an open-ended mapping, without distinguishing constrained cases such as `dict[str, int]` from `dict[str, Any]`.","span_ids":["span1","span3"]},{"claim_id":"claim2","claim_type":"core","weight":40,"statement":"When `response_format` is supported, `JSONAdapter._json_adapter_call_common` checks for that mapping condition and immediately sets `lm_kwargs[\"response_format\"]` to `{\"type\": \"json_object\"}` before calling the LM, rather than using a structured-output schema.","span_ids":["span2"]},{"claim_id":"claim3","claim_type":"supporting","weight":20,"statement":"Structured-output schema generation independently rejects any `dict`-origin output field by raising `ValueError`, so such signatures are not eligible for the strict structured response format even if the early fallback were bypassed.","span_ids":["span3"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"span1","path":"dspy/adapters/json_adapter.py","start_line":27,"end_line":37},{"span_id":"span2","path":"dspy/adapters/json_adapter.py","start_line":45,"end_line":56},{"span_id":"span3","path":"dspy/adapters/json_adapter.py","start_line":212,"end_line":231}]}
